# Product Development 101: How to build your brand-defining product


###


Have an idea for a skin care or cosmetics product but not sure where to begin? This four-step process guide helps you figure out how to get from one-man-show to indie beauty brand, and how to get your great ideas from dream to shelf.


Posted in[Product Development](https://solesence.com/category/productdevelopment/) .
